protocol.scope: Unknown material, known boundary geometry and parameters; position-driven interactions and known gravity. Not unknown-boundary recovery or end-to-end reconstruction.

material_distribution.two_object_materials: Independent draws; fixed across calibration and both queries
material_distribution.constitutive_family: Log-J Neo-Hookean; analytic control knows family, not parameters

observations.visibility: Fixed material surface subset: y=0 or z=1 faces; no camera-occlusion claim
unknown: material parameters and spatial material field

geometry.scope: Interaction and material transfer at fixed object geometry; no unseen-shape claim

rendering.scope: Object-only controlled shared appearance; environment occlusion and independent reconstruction quality not claimed
rendering.transport: Same author K16 transport on a common 5x5x5 material grid for every method and reference
rendering.primary_image_average: Exclude identical starting frame; retain all-frame values separately
rendering.lpips: AlexNet v0.1; RGB converted to [-1,1]; full-image score, with foreground-union PSNR/SSIM reported separately

common_physical_metrics.volume: Signed tetrahedron ratios on common 7x7x7 material grid; sampled folds, not continuous validity proof
common_physical_metrics.impulse: Net nongravitational body impulse from known masses and saved velocities; no individual force decomposition
common_physical_metrics.contact: Same 386-point material surface; normalized implicit bowl gap and sampled vertex-to-triangle pair gap; event resolution 2 ms

ours.calibration: Powell: up to 64 evaluations, then up to 128 additional evaluations initialized from the best sealed calibration fit; identical spatial parameterization and bounds; calibration loss selects the final parameters.
ours.material_network: Frozen prior decoder plus independent compressibility extension

analytic-control.calibration: Powell: up to 64 evaluations, then up to 128 additional evaluations initialized from the best sealed calibration fit; identical spatial parameterization and bounds; calibration loss selects the final parameters.

spring-gaus.calibration: Scalar stiffness search (initial value plus at most 12 bounded iterations), then 40 Adam iterations for per-edge stiffness and damping
spring-gaus.adaptation: Author internal force/integrator; common boundary adapter; exact dense KNN compatibility

phystwin.adaptation: Author Warp spring force and sealed-forecast integrator; common boundary adapter; fixed zero damping

uniphy.calibration: 8 fixed-seed latent-centroid initializations, then 8 AdamW iterations
uniphy.adaptation: Released demo pretrained networks and MPM; fixed bowl/sphere collision hooks; optional adjoint bridge
uniphy.contact_law_limit: Native separating-velocity projection differs from the conservative penalty boundary used by the reference and other adapters; report as a capability comparison, not matched contact-law material inference
uniphy.gradient_limit: Short derivative tests remain coordinate-sensitive; disclose adaptation and incomplete qualification

reference.contact_sampling: Mesh-aligned surface sampling for deformable pairs
reference.refinement: n6 repeats for world 0 in every family and both queries; disclose mean/peak differences
reference.qualification: Positive sampled orientation is necessary, not a convergence or nonintersection proof

metrics: contact penetration and timing where representation supports it
body impulse where state/mass exports support it
shared-renderer PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS on fixed withheld cameras
protocol.aggregation: Average two queries within world; report per-family and world-level paired differences with world bootstrap intervals; frames are not independent samples
protocol.failures: Retain every planned slot. Separate unsupported, fit failure, rollout failure, invalid reference and numerical-reference uncertainty. Unsupported or failed-reference slots never count as method wins.
freeze_requirements: Completed development-case audit or explicit recorded terminal failure for every method-supported slot
Chosen method settings and numeric reference policy fixed
Source commit and environment/checkpoint hashes saved
Metrics and rendering protocol implemented and checked
No held reference or prediction used for tuning
